name: creator-skills
description: Content-creation skill suites for AI agents: video localization, original video production, Xiaohongshu image-text cards, and novel promotion videos. Source repos stay canonical; this repo is the one-command installer.

plugins.name: video-localization
plugins.description: Bring an existing video over the language barrier: download it, transcribe, subtitle, and optionally re-voice it in Chinese.

plugins.name: video-production
plugins.description: Produce an original video from source material: planning, provider-agnostic voiceover, and 4K render polish.

plugins.name: image-text-cards
plugins.description: Turn articles and posts into vertical 3:4 image-text card decks for Xiaohongshu (小红书).

plugins.name: novel-promotion
plugins.description: Scout novels worth promoting and produce the promo video: selection, copywriting, source assembly, narration.
